commit_and_push_tickets_branch uses git add -A which sweeps in per-pass timestamps that should be excluded from selective 5-file staging
a shared locked commit helper with optional pathspec support allows scoped staging (paths=None defaults to -A; paths=<sequence> uses git status/add -- <paths>)
_commit_binding_store_snapshot must route through the locked seam with paths restricted to the 5 existing .bridge_state files and strict=True to preserve fail-open contract
per-file idempotency (bug 1e08) requires pathspec-scoped git status to report changes only in the named files, ensuring dirty non-allowlisted files do not trigger commits
the raw-git-ok marker on reconcile_helpers.py is removed once _commit_binding_store_snapshot uses the locked pathspec-capable commit seam instead of raw git_adapter calls
